record.paper_title: Some problems and conjectures about L2-invariants
record.original_question: For a group G and any normal chain {G_i} with trivial intersection, are the L2-Betti numbers of G approximated by those of the quotients G/G_i? Equivalently, for every matrix A ∈ M_{r,s}(QG), does dim_{N(G)} ker(r_A^{(2)}) equal lim_{i→∞} dim_{N(G/G_i)} ker(r_{A[i]}^{(2)}), and for every finite-type G-CW-complex X, does b_n^{(2)}(X; N(G)) equal lim_{i→∞} b_n^{(2)}(X[i]; N(G/G_i)) for all n ≥ 0?

evidence.quote: Conjecture 7.1 (Approximation Conjecture for L2-Betti numbers). A group G satisfies the Approximation Conjecture for L2-Betti numbers if for any normal chain {Gi} one of the following equivalent conditions holds ... dimN(G)(ker r(2)A) = lim i→∞ dimN(G/Gi)(ker r(2)A[i]); ... Let X be a G-CW-complex of finite type ... we get for n ≥ 0 b(2)n (X; N (G)) = lim i→∞ b(2)n (X[i]; N (G/Gi)).

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $G$ be a (discrete) group with group von Neumann algebra $\mathcal{N}(G)$, equipped with its canonical faithful normal trace, and let $\dim_{\mathcal{N}(G)}$ denote the corresponding extended dimension function on $\mathcal{N}(G)$-modules. For a matrix $A\in M_{r,s}(\mathbb{Q}G)$, let $r_A^{(2)}\colon \ell^2(G)^r\to \ell^2(G)^s$ denote right multiplication by $A$. For a $G$-CW-complex $X$ of finite type, let $b_n^{(2)}(X;\mathcal{N}(G))=\dim_{\mathcal{N}(G)} H_n^{(2)}(X)$ be its $n$-th $L^2$-Betti number.

A normal chain in $G$ is a descending sequence $G=G_0\supseteq G_1\supseteq G_2\supseteq\cdots$ of normal subgroups; it is said to have trivial intersection if $\bigcap_{i\ge 0} G_i=\{1\}$. For such a chain, write $A[i]\in M_{r,s}(\mathbb{Q}[G/G_i])$ for the image of $A$ under the quotient map $\mathbb{Q}G\to\mathbb{Q}[G/G_i]$, and $X[i]=G_i\backslash X$ for the induced $(G/G_i)$-CW-complex.

Question: Is it true that for every group $G$ and every normal chain $\{G_i\}_{i\ge 0}$ in $G$ with $\bigcap_i G_i=\{1\}$, the following equivalent equalities hold?

(a) For every $A\in M_{r,s}(\mathbb{Q}G)$,
$$\dim_{\mathcal{N}(G)}\ker\bigl(r_A^{(2)}\bigr)\;=\;\lim_{i\to\infty}\dim_{\mathcal{N}(G/G_i)}\ker\bigl(r_{A[i]}^{(2)}\bigr).$$

(b) For every $G$-CW-complex $X$ of finite type and every $n\ge 0$,
$$b_n^{(2)}\bigl(X;\mathcal{N}(G)\bigr)\;=\;\lim_{i\to\infty} b_n^{(2)}\bigl(X[i];\mathcal{N}(G/G_i)\bigr).$$
artifact.status_search_result: The Approximation Conjecture for $L^2$-Betti numbers in the stated generality (arbitrary normal chains with trivial intersection, without finite-index or residual-finiteness hypotheses) is open. It is known to hold in several important special cases — most notably Lück's theorem for descending chains of finite-index normal subgroups with trivial intersection, and various extensions (e.g. by Jaikin-Zapirain and others, including results in positive characteristic and for the first $L^2$-Betti number) — but the full conjecture remains a standard open problem in the field.

status_evidence.title: L2-Betti numbers in group theory (Löh, lecture notes)
status_evidence.snippet: Lück's approximation theorem covers chains of finite-index normal subgroups with trivial intersection; general approximation remains conjectural.
status_evidence.claim: Lück approximation is established for finite-index normal chains; general case is conjectural.

status_evidence.title: The first L^2-Betti number and approximation in arbitrary characteristic
status_evidence.snippet: Studies approximation of the first L^2-Betti number along chains; partial results in arbitrary characteristic.
status_evidence.claim: Only partial results known beyond the classical setting.

status_evidence.title: L^2-determinant class and approximation of L^2-Betti numbers
status_evidence.snippet: Approximation results assuming determinant class and related hypotheses, indicating the general conjecture is open.
status_evidence.claim: General approximation conjecture requires additional hypotheses currently.
